analysis.title: Setting up for an AI squeeze? (Leopold lows 2.0)
key_insights: Global equity net selling hit -2.1 standard deviations in one session, with long sales outpacing short sales roughly 3 to 1. Goldman (Lin) reads this as outright risk reduction rather than added shorts.
The US accounted for 66% of global net selling, led by tech. Korea and Taiwan also saw heavy liquidation.
Global AI stocks had their second-largest net selling in a year (-2.8 Z-score).
Hedge funds have net sold global AI stocks for five consecutive sessions. Per Goldman, cumulative net buying of AI stocks since the start of 2025 has been completely reversed.

Hedge fund net allocation to global AI stocks fell to 26.1% from 31.7% at the June peak, now at the 49th percentile over the past year. The aggregate long/short ratio dropped from 4.34 to 3.27, the 7th percentile over the past year.

SOX has fallen sharply over recent sessions and is extremely oversold. It has reached the lower boundary of its trading range, which has held on numerous occasions, and is testing its longer-term trend line.
VXSMH (semiconductor vol) has surged after weeks of complacency, which the note treats as a contrarian ingredient.

Leopold reportedly bought CoreWeave and other AI-related calls in early September. The CRWV November $95 call fell from a high of $18 to $1 since September 8. The note has not established which options Leopold actually bought, but the contract has substantial open interest.
The note suggests an options unwind may have amplified the selloff: dealers who bought delta to hedge call exposure may have been forced to sell as the calls lost value.

DRAM has fallen back to the 'Leopold lows' and CRWV's RSI is back at levels last seen during the initial selloff. The note frames washed-out positioning, crushed options and oversold technicals as a possible second chance for a relief rally.

sector_views.rationale: The note sees a potential contrarian relief rally setup after positioning cleaned up and SOX hit extreme oversold levels at range support. It does not issue a formal rating or call.

risk_factors: Forced selling may not yet be exhausted.
The Leopold options positions are not confirmed, so the link between his reported call purchases and the CRWV $95 contract is an inference by the note.
A break of the SOX range lower boundary or longer-term trend line would undercut the oversold-support argument.

tension_points.bull_case: Hedge funds have fully reversed cumulative 2025 AI net buying, the long/short ratio is at the 7th percentile, SOX is at range support and its trend line, VXSMH has spiked, and the CRWV options are crushed, all of which fits a contrarian setup.
tension_points.bear_case: Selling was driven by long liquidation, with AI net selling at a -2.8 Z-score, and forced selling may not be exhausted. Allocation at the 49th percentile is not extreme.
tension_points.what_invalidates: SOX breaking below the lower boundary of its trading range and its longer-term trend line.
